subject: Admissions & JoSAA
question: What role does JoSAA (Joint Seat Allocation Authority) play after JEE Main and JEE Advanced results are declared?
options: It manages unified seat allocation across IITs, NITs, IIITs, and participating GFTIs
It conducts Class 10 board examinations across all Indian states
It grades university semester lab notebooks manually
It issues driver's licenses for robotics competitions

explanation.why: JoSAA coordinates joint registration, choice filling, and multi-round seat allotment across central institutes (IIT+ System & NIT+ System) in one portal.
explanation.shortcut: JoSAA = Joint Seat Allocation Authority for IITs + NITs + IIITs + GFTIs.
explanation.commonTrap: You must separately register and lock choices on the JoSAA portal—getting a JEE rank alone does not allot a seat.

subject: Admissions & JoSAA
question: In JoSAA seat allotment rounds, match each willingness option in List I with its exact behavior in List II.

right: Accept current seat and remain open only to higher-preference branches within the SAME institute
Accept current seat permanently and opt out of further upgrades
Accept current seat provisionally and stay open to ANY higher-preference choice across institutes

explanation.why: Freeze locks your allotted seat; Float considers all higher preferences above it across any institute; Slide considers only higher-preference branches inside the same allotted institute.
explanation.shortcut: Freeze = Stop | Slide = Upgrade inside Same Campus | Float = Upgrade across Any Higher Choice.
explanation.commonTrap: Selecting Freeze early prevents you from getting a higher-ranked preference in later rounds.

subject: Admissions & JoSAA
question: Which practices help students avoid last-minute counseling disqualification during engineering admissions? (Select all that apply)
options: Keeping Class 10/12 marksheets, category/income certificates (if applicable), and photo ID verified early
Monitoring official counseling schedules and seat acceptance fee deadlines
Checking opening/closing rank trends safely while including realistic backup preferences
Waiting until after final round closing times to create a login account

explanation.why: Timely document readiness, deadline tracking, and realistic preference lists protect seat offers from accidental cancellation.
explanation.shortcut: Verify documents + respect deadlines + build dream/match/safe choices.
explanation.commonTrap: Missing online document verification or fee payment deadlines forfeits an allotted seat automatically.
